title: He had everything.
paragraphs: He had everything.
Glory. Honor. Heaven’s wealth beyond measure.
And then—He chose poverty.

“For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.” — Second Epistle to the Corinthians 8:9
Let that hit.

Jesus didn’t lose His riches by accident.
He laid them down—on purpose.

Not because you were worthy.
Not because you earned it.
Because you were broke in spirit… and didn’t even know it.

Sin had bankrupted your soul.
Empty.
Hopeless.
Separated.
But here’s what we miss…

The cross wasn’t just suffering.
It was a divine exchange.

He took your poverty—your guilt, your shame, your rebellion.
And in return, He offers you His riches—righteousness, forgiveness, sonship.

Not temporary relief.
Eternal inheritance.
That’s grace.

Not a loan.
Not a paycheck.
A gift soaked in blood and mercy.
And here’s the question that lingers—
What are you doing with that gift?

Still living like you’re poor?
Still chasing things that can’t satisfy?

Brother, sister… you’ve been made rich in Christ.
Walk like it.

Turn from sin.
Receive His grace fully.
Live like heaven already touched your life.
Jesus became poor so you wouldn’t stay empty.
So come home.
